title: A profile event (§2.6: profile, favorites, prefs, history, photo)

oneOf.title: profile

eid.description: The event's id, made once by the Encore that made the event (str(uuid4())). Idempotent: the same eid twice is one event.

uid.description: The profile (user) the event belongs to.

at.description: When it happened: unix time in seconds, with milliseconds (e.g. 1795200000.123), from the clock of the Encore that made it (an edit: when it was made, kept strictly increasing per Encore; history: when the song ended; a merge re-sends events with their original at). Latest-wins rules compare (at, eid): a higher at wins, an equal at goes to the higher eid (as a string).

pin_hash.description: The 4-digit profile PIN as a salted scrypt hash (hashlib.scrypt(pin, salt, n, r, p, dklen=32), hex), or null = no PIN. Synced so the PIN works on every Encore; never shown to a browser, never in an export.

created.description: When the profile was made (unix seconds).

deleted.description: true = a tombstone: the profile is deleted everywhere. It wins over every other event for that uid, whatever their at; later events for that uid are dropped.

merged_into.description: Only with deleted: true: the profile was merged into this one (the merging Encore already re-sent the favourites, prefs and history under it). Players move what they keep locally for the old uid (remembered phones) to it.

oneOf.description: The whole profile record (latest (at, eid) wins for the whole record), or a tombstone (deleted: true, only eid/stream/uid/at and optionally merged_into needed).

song.description: The catalog song id (job id; f-... for scanned songs). A card with two lyric languages is two songs: Encore hearts the card's first song and un-hearts all of them.

key.description: Known today: "guide" (off|low|medium|full) and "style:<lang>" (normal|both|both_original|original|romaji|kana|timing|none; lang = the catalog's language code, or "other"). Store unknown keys as they are.

value.description: null = unset (the song sheet starts on the host's pick).

style.description: Optional: the lyric style (both, both_original, original, romaji, kana, none, timing; null = the plain .ass).

title.description: Optional: the song's title when it was sung (for history of songs no longer in the library).

score.description: Optional (added 2026-11-20): the singing score, when the song was scored. Synced untouched with the rest of the history.

oneOf.description: Append-only: one event per user per song sung (a duet sung by two users is two events). at = when it ended.

photo.description: The profile picture: the sha256 (hex) of its JPEG, whose bytes go up with PUT /api/encore/profiles/<uid>/photo/<sha256> before this event is sent and come down with GET on the same path; null: the picture was removed. Latest (at, eid) wins, as for the profile record.

description: One profile event (§2.6). The stream decides its shape.

words.description: Optional: the words part (§2.9); left out when the words weren't scored.

partial.description: Optional: true when the song was skipped or stopped before its end.

score.description: The singing score (added 2026-11-20; §2.4, §2.6). The Studio stores it and never needs it.
